benefits.en: The two groups stood shoulder to shoulder.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以把「互相支持、保持團結、為共同目標緊密合作」等較長意思濃縮成較短的說法。

benefits.titleEn: It Shows Stronger Support Than “Work Together”
benefits.titleZh: 比 work together 表達更強的支持
benefits.en: unity; loyalty; shared difficulty; full support; a common goal. Shoulder to shoulder
benefits.zh: Work together 可能只表示一起完成工作。 Shoulder to shoulder 通常進一步表示：

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Support During Difficult Times
benefits.titleZh: 適合表達困難時期的支持
benefits.en: a friend faces a problem; a team suffers a loss; a family needs help; a town faces danger; workers ask for fair treatment. We will stand shoulder to shoulder with the family.

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented General Origin; Exact First Figurative Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 整體來源有較充分記錄；確切首次比喻用法不明

history.en: Historical records connect stand shoulder to shoulder with soldiers standing closely together in formation from the late sixteenth century. Etymonline dates this military use to the 1580s.
history.zh: 歷史記錄把 stand shoulder to shoulder 與十六世紀末士兵緊密列隊的情況連繫起來。 現有資料顯示，這種軍事用法至少在1580年代已經出現。

history.en: Soldiers in a close line faced the same direction and depended on the people beside them. The physical picture therefore became a natural image of unity, cooperation and mutual support.
history.zh: 緊密列隊的士兵朝着相同方向，並依靠身旁的人。 這個實際畫面因此逐漸成為團結、合作及互相支持的象徵。

origin.memoryEn: People whose shoulders form one line appear ready to face the same problem together.
origin.memoryZh: 當人們肩並肩排成一線時，便像是準備共同面對同一個問題。
